inputSource: Synthetic native bridge, regular model update and render; official SDK/TCP acceptance is separate.
method: Project actual renderer kart group world positions with the real before-sample camera view and projection matrices. Camera is frozen only in this offline analysis, never written into the game. Positive NDC x is screen right. This does not use game.x sign to define screen direction.
checks: right input increases projected screen x
left input decreases projected screen x
